cohort: 136 predominantly low-income and ethnic minority women of mixed parity in the United States
finding: Higher third-trimester stress was associated with worse childbirth experiences, particularly in relation to feelings of control and capability and perceived safety, independent of sociodemographic factors and mode of delivery.
mod_finding: An unplanned cesarean delivery was associated with worse childbirth experiences overall, while vaginal delivery was associated with greater perceived safety.
